name: deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2
summary: 通过 Python 的 faster-whisper 使用 Whisper large-v3-turbo 模型转写音频。发布者列出英语、中文、日语等八种语言，并演示如何用 `WhisperModel("deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2")` 加载模型。示例仅演示模型加载，未展示如何传入音频。

Transcribe audio in Python with the Whisper large-v3-turbo model through faster-whisper. The publisher lists eight languages, including English, Chinese, and Japanese, and shows how to load the model with `WhisperModel("deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2")`. The example stops at model loading and does not show how to submit audio.
